title: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(6)
desc: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(6)

paragraphs.en: Seen one way, Doge exposed the limits of Muskism as a mode of governance.
paragraphs.zh: 从某种角度来看，政府效率部揭示了马斯克主义作为一种治理模式的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Companies can treat workers as disposable units because the surrounding state guarantees their basic existence.
paragraphs.zh: 公司可以将工人视为可随意处置的单位，因为周边的国家保障了他们的基本生存。

paragraphs.en: Musk had ruthlessly deleted workers at his own companies and made deft use of labour law's loopholes, but in seeking to make real cuts at Doge, he collided with the fragile contract at the core of American life – misleadingly called "entitlements", but better understood as the survival infrastructure for many millions of people.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克曾在自己公司无情裁员，并巧妙利用劳动法漏洞，但在政府效率部试图进行实质性裁员时，他撞上了美国生活核心的脆弱契约——这个被误导性称为"应享权益"的体系，更准确的理解应是数百万人的生存基础设施。

paragraphs.en: As Americans vented their anger at feared or actual loss of access to social security and Medicare benefits, Musk's reputation suffered.
paragraphs.zh: 随着美国人对可能或实际失去社会保障和医疗保险福利的愤怒情绪爆发，马斯克的声誉受到了损害。

paragraphs.en: Musk had imagined Doge as the realisation of the dream of reactionary technocracy, in which engineers disciplined society like a factory floor. But society is not a factory.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克曾将政府效率部设想为反动技术官僚梦想的实现，在这个梦想中，工程师们像管理工厂车间一样规训社会。但社会不是工厂。

paragraphs.en: It encompasses children, elderly people, disabled people, the geographically stranded – the very categories of life that markets define as surplus.
paragraphs.zh: 它涵盖了儿童、老年人、残疾人、地理上被困的人——这些正是市场定义为过剩的人群类别。

paragraphs.en: In trying to impose a cyborg logic of optimisation, Musk discovered that humans were not programmable units, and that the public sector's role is precisely to provide goods that the private sector can't or won't.
paragraphs.zh: 在试图强加一种赛博格式的优化逻辑时，马斯克发现人类并非可编程的单元，而且公共部门的作用恰恰是提供私营部门无法或不愿提供的产品。

paragraphs.en: The conflation of codebase, company and state didn't work.
paragraphs.zh: 代码库、公司和国家的混淆没有奏效。

paragraphs.en: From another angle, of course, it was the state that instrumentalised Musk.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，从另一个角度来看，是政府利用了马斯克。

paragraphs.en: Trump's circle used Musk to wage war on the "woke" domains of higher education, foreign aid and scientific research under the cover of "efficiency" while attacking the administrative state and terrorising the federal workforce.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普的圈子利用马斯克，以"效率"为幌子，对高等教育、对外援助和科学研究等"觉醒"领域发动战争，同时攻击行政国家，恐吓联邦工作人员。

paragraphs.en: Doge also gave an experimental prod to the flesh of the welfare state to see how the body politic responded.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部还对福利国家的体制进行了一次试验性的推动，以观察政治体制会作何反应。

paragraphs.en: When resistance surged, Musk absorbed the blame, but many of the changes remained.
paragraphs.zh: 当阻力激增时，马斯克承担了责任，但许多变革措施仍得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the most important was the federal government's expanded capacity for domestic surveillance, as facilitated through Doge's data-integration efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 也许最重要的是联邦政府在国内监控方面能力的提升，这是通过政府效率部的数据整合工作得以实现的。

paragraphs.en: In this sense, Muskism proved not a governing philosophy but a toolkit available to those who govern.  The end of Doge can thus be read in two ways.
paragraphs.zh: 从这个意义上说，马斯克主义并非一种治理哲学，而是可供治理者使用的工具包。因此，政府效率部的结局可以从两种角度来解读。

paragraphs.en: One is personal: Musk's overreach, his inability to transform celebrity capital into co-leadership of the state.
paragraphs.zh: 一个是个人的原因：马斯克的越界行为，以及他无法将名人资本转化为与国家共同领导的能力。

paragraphs.en: The other is structural: the deeper implantation of contractors such as Palantir into the backend of government.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个是结构性的：像帕兰提尔这样的承包商更深入地嵌入政府后端系统。

paragraphs.en: For all the pyrotechnics of the feud with Trump that unfolded after Musk's departure from Washington, Musk's companies continued to be awarded new Pentagon contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管马斯克离开华盛顿后与特朗普的纷争闹得沸沸扬扬，但马斯克的公司仍不断获得五角大楼的新合同。

paragraphs.en: In July 2025, Musk's company xAI announced that it had entered a contract with the Department of Defense for its "Grok for Government" suite of AI products.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年7月，马斯克的xAI公司宣布已与美国国防部签订合同，为其"面向政府的格罗克"系列AI产品提供支持。

paragraphs.en: This happened the same day that the company introduced "Ani", an animated AI companion that can engage in sexually explicit conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 这件事发生在该公司推出“阿妮”的同一天，“阿妮”是一个能进行露骨色情对话的动画人工智能伙伴。

paragraphs.en: Summing up the situation, one headline read: "Grok rolls out pornographic anime companion, lands Department of Defense contract."
paragraphs.zh: 总结这一情况，一则新闻标题写道："格罗克推出色情动漫伴侣，同时获得国防部合同。"

paragraphs.en: In 2026, the core themes of Muskism are more visible than ever.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年，马斯克主义的核心主题比以往任何时候都更加明显。

paragraphs.en: In February, xAI signed a deal to deploy its AI bot Grok on classified military networks – just in time for the US-Israeli war on Iran.
paragraphs.zh: 2月，xAI签署了一项协议，将其AI机器人格罗克部署在机密军事网络上——正好赶上美国-以色列对伊朗的战争。

paragraphs.en: In March, a former Doge employee in his 20s who gutted the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and retweeted Nazi apologist Nick Fuentes was appointed chief data officer in charge of AI at the Department of War.
paragraphs.zh: 3月，一名20多岁的前政府效率部员工被任命为国防部负责人工智能的首席数据官，他曾削弱消费者金融保护局的职能，并转发过纳粹辩护者尼克·富恩特斯的推文。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the White House posts propaganda videos on X that blend video games, memes and real-life drone footage shot from the battlefield.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，白宫在X平台上发布宣传视频，将电子游戏、表情包和战场实拍的无人机画面融合在一起。

paragraphs.en: The line between digital and political power, between gaming and government, between speedrunning and statesmanship, has disappeared. Welcome to life under Muskism.
paragraphs.zh: 数字力量与政治权力之间的界限，游戏与治理之间的界限，速通游戏与治国理政之间的界限，已经消失。欢迎来到马斯克主义下的生活。
